summary: Approved as readable, behavior-validated unmatched C++; zero matching-source byte credit.
reason: Source control flow, fastcall ABI, 48-byte layout, partial writes and null skip agree with independently byte-checked original assembly and caller evidence. Submitted tests call the original and check all buffer bytes. An independent optimized i386 countercheck passed 21,845 cases plus null and zero-count checks. Source hashes match validation, and native Windows compilation records concern the actual implementation. Fault behavior, large-count wraparound and native-width port differences are explicitly limited; sampled validation does not establish all-input equivalence or exact matching.
